summary: The multiplicativity argument, Brunn--Minkowski survival properties and threshold identities, and the scalar log-concave comparison are all correct. The single-crossing argument is justified by discrete concavity of log(u_m/r^m), the geometric comparator estimate is valid coefficientwise, and the factorized multivariate conclusion follows exactly. Boundary cases, finite support, and the contextual use of the accepted predecessor fact are handled without gaps.
